name: Repo Run Check
description: Before running a GitHub repo or a pasted shell command, flags risky install scripts, curl-pipe-to-shell patterns, editor autorun tasks, typosquatted dependencies and fake-star signals. Tools: check_repo, check_command and full_report_info (free), plus the optional paid tool full_report (deeper check of 1-3 repos, 0.25 USDC on Base over x402; unpaid calls return the payment terms). No account or API key.
author: devx-agent
